answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 7472 Country: India Title: I have two questions. 1. If any non-muslim greet me with Asslaamuleyikum, Shall i reply him/her with Waaleyikumussalaam??? What does quraan and our shariaah says about this. 2. If any non-muslim wish to go inside the mosque and see it, Shall i bring him/her in the mosque. What does quraan and our shariaah says about this. Question: Assalaamualeyiukum, I have two questions. 1. If any non-muslim greet me with Asslaamuleyikum, Shall i reply him/her with Waaleyikumussalaam??? What does quraan and our shariaah says about this. 2. If any non-muslim wish to go inside the mosque and see it, Shall i bring him/her in the mosque. What does quraan and our shariaah says about this. Jazaakumullah! Answer ID: 7472 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 882/882=M/1429) Reply greeting of a non-Muslim with: وعلیک or ھداک اللہ . (2) A non-Muslim can enter mosque provided it is not intending desecration. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
